experiments.result: Three private PC cases from two independent source groups have length 449680, identical exact UE headers, valid GVAS markers, and stored SHA-1 values that independently match SHA-1 over 0x40..EOF. Their encrypted members are distinct AES-block sequences without plaintext GVAS. Build and DLC metadata remain unknown.

A Rust-edited encrypted save loaded with Life Stone 25, Chakra Drop 15, and Medicine 30. Each item was used once. The in-game resave stored 24, 14, and 29 at item-table offsets 0x4C73, 0x4C74, and 0x4C7D. This confirms normal one-byte decrement and persistence for all three released consumables.

A Rust-edited encrypted save loaded and resaved successfully in-game with Macca 8,210,492 and Glory 100. During the test, normal game actions changed Macca to 8,234,422 (+23,930) and Glory to 10 (-90). The game preserved both fields as little-endian u32 values at 0x3D32 and 0x3D4A and applied normal currency arithmetic.

A controlled private PC pair captured immediately before and after the first legal acquisition of the Aogami Type-8 husk. Item ID 551 at 0x4E99 changed from 0 to 1, and linked metadata at 0x5219 changed from 0x00 to 0x02. This confirms the never-acquired state 0/0x00 and first-acquired new state 1/0x02 for this Aogami slot. The other 30 changed payload bytes are gameplay, time, position, and related interaction state.

Selecting the legacy ownership checkbox for Aogami Type-C on a private PC save changed only item ID 558 at offset 0x4EA0 from 0 to 1. A later in-game test showed that this single-byte edit did not make Type-C present. It records the checkbox behavior, not a complete semantic addition. Both encrypted sources pass complete validation. Game build and DLC metadata remain unknown.

An in-game test of the ownership-only Rust edit left Aogami Type-C absent and showed only Aogami Type-6 present. In the tested source, Type-6 metadata at 0x5217 is 0x06. Metadata for the absent Type-1 through Type-5, Type-7, and Type-A through Type-C entries is 0x16. The legacy flags define 0x10 as Absent, 0x04 as Owned, and 0x02 as New. This disproves ownership-byte-only semantic mutation.

A controlled private PC pair captured immediately before and after legally reacquiring an Aogami Type-C husk that had been acquired previously. Item ID 558 at 0x4EA0 changed from 0 to 1, and linked metadata at 0x5220 changed from 0x16 to 0x06. The transition exactly matches the released Rust linked mutation. The other 35 changed payload bytes are gameplay, time, position, and related interaction state.

An in-game test of the corrected linked Rust edit showed Aogami Type-C present in both Essence Fusion and the main-menu Essence list, and the essence was usable. The same save showed Aogami entries with item amount 1 in Essence Fusion while the main-menu list marked entries with metadata 0x16 as Absent. Type-6 and corrected Type-C had metadata 0x06 and appeared present in the main-menu list. This confirms that the item byte and metadata flags control distinct linked surfaces.

A valid in-game resave after purchasing Nozuchi's Essence changed item ID 570 at 0x4EAC from 0 to 1 and its +0x380 metadata byte at 0x522C from 0x16 to 0x06. The same resave preserved the Rust-edited Aogami Type-C bytes exactly at ownership 0x4EA0=1 and metadata 0x5220=0x06. This independently confirms the linked address rule and flag transition for a non-Aogami essence.

A private PC save with Aogami Type-1 through Type-7 and Type-A through Type-C ownership checkboxes cleared was compared with the validated baseline for profile smtvv-pc-gamesave-449680. Item IDs 544 through 550 and 556 through 557 changed from 1 to 0 at offsets 0x4E92 through 0x4E98 and 0x4E9E through 0x4E9F. Item ID 558 for Type-C was 0 in both files. Metadata did not change, and a later game test showed that Type-6 remained present. Both encrypted sources pass complete validation. Game build and DLC metadata remain unknown.

One private PC save contains five relevant amount/metadata patterns among named essences: 162 at 0/0x00, 10 at 1/0x02, 68 at 1/0x06, 47 at 0/0x16, and 9 at 1/0x16. Legacy is_new behavior and current UI evidence support, but do not yet prove, that 0/0x00 is never acquired, 1/0x02 is first-acquired and new, 1/0x06 is present and acknowledged, 0/0x16 is previously acquired and consumed, and 1/0x16 is a split state.

A valid in-game resave after purchasing Nozuchi's Essence reduced Macca at 0x3D32 from 8,210,492 to 8,207,492, a 3,000 Macca purchase. Glory at 0x3D4A remained 72. This confirms both little-endian u32 reads and the Macca write location for profile smtvv-pc-gamesave-449680.

Two valid private PC saves before and after an in-game session changed equal little-endian u32 values at 0x4FD and 0x5D0 from 144,550 to 144,624 seconds (+74). This confirms linked save-screen and runtime play-time copies for profile smtvv-pc-gamesave-449680.

A Rust-edited encrypted save loaded with both play-time copies set to 36,000 seconds (10:00:00). After one tested minute and an in-game resave, both linked u32 values at 0x4FD and 0x5D0 were 36,060 seconds. The game preserved equality and advanced both copies by exactly 60 seconds.
